returnsAuthorized.description: Authorizations whose authorizedAt falls on the day (both "opened" and "approved").

returnsReceived.description: Receipts (ReturnCompleted) whose receivedAt falls on the day.

timeToReceiveSamples.description: The day's receipts whose authorization is also projected; the population of the two percentiles.

timeToReceiveP50Seconds.description: Continuous p50 of receivedAt - authorizedAt in seconds; null without a sample.

timeToReceiveP95Seconds.description: Continuous p95 of receivedAt - authorizedAt in seconds; null without a sample.

reasonPareto.description: The range's authorizations grouped by reason code, most frequent first (ties by reason), at most 5 entries.

reason.description: The enum reason code of the authorization (never free text).

share.description: returns over ALL authorizations of the range.

cumulativeShare.description: The running sum of the shares in Pareto order.

400.description: invalid-report-range. `from` or `to` is not a date (YYYY-MM-DD), `from` is after `to`, or the range exceeds 366 days.

type.description: The kebab-case slug of the error category.

500.description: An unexpected failure; the body never leaks the internal error.

type.description: The kebab-case slug of the error category.
